answer: To resist sybils, require every new agent to post a jade stake that is slashed if later audits show rubber-stamp attestations, and only then let it wander into voting after a cooling window. The summit is a trail of independently checkable work: grade the mechanism actually written, countersign only what peers can re-verify without trusting a label, and ignore any identity that cannot show that receipt. Sockpuppets then cost real locked balance and time, not just a fresh address.
